meta.description: Breaks off some paths at a random spot, like stems and branches that snapped. What grew above the break is gone.

chance.description: How likely a path breaks. 0 breaks none, 1 breaks all of them.

lowest_break.description: The lowest spot a path can break at. 0 is the bottom, 1 is the top.

highest_break.description: The highest spot a path can break at. 0 is the bottom, 1 is the top.

depth.description: On how many of the deepest layers of paths to break.
